items.title: The Reality Experiment
items.reason: University volunteers enter an unknown experiment that begins destabilizing reality itself, making the hook an escalating artificial system whose rules and consequences must be understood.

items.title: Chimera Strain
items.reason: A scientist pursues a cure for a lethal genetic disease by decoding the biological immortality of Turritopsis jellyfish, keeping genetics, experimental biology and unintended consequences central.

items.title: Errors of the Human Body
items.reason: A genetic researcher joins a molecular-biology institute, investigates a secret regeneration-gene project and uncovers a lethal experimental virus and conspiracy, strongly matching the science-first mystery profile.
A repeating day is traced to an illegal particle-accelerator experiment, turning the time loop into a solvable scientific phenomenon rather than a purely symbolic device.

items.title: Reset
items.reason: A research scientist uses experimental wormhole technology to enter parallel timelines, with unstable test results and repeated interventions revealing consequences of the system even though the plot carries more action than the strongest matches.

items.title: ReGenesis
items.reason: A biotechnology team of geneticists, virologists and microbiologists investigates biological threats and scientific anomalies, making active scientific problem-solving the core of the series rather than background flavor.

items.title: Eleventh Hour
items.reason: A government scientist and FBI handler investigate dangerous experiments, rare diseases, neurological anomalies and environmental threats episode by episode — exceptionally close to the scientific-investigation side of Fringe.
aliases: Eleventh Hour: Einsatz in letzter Sekunde

items.title: Surface
items.reason: A marine biologist investigates the worldwide emergence of an unknown sea species while government secrecy grows around it, combining biology, ecology, conspiracy and sustained phenomenon discovery.
